Updates

Project updates

Each item below corresponds to a merged pull request. The PR link opens the full implementation and review history.

September 24, 2026 · PR #25

Centralize active match publication

Moved live match recipient selection, authorization, projection, and delivery into one publisher. The match handler now reports explicit completion outcomes, and v2 tests cover an exact retry after a committed update loses its acknowledgement.

September 24, 2026 · PR #24

Fix saved match resume projection and checkpoint recovery

Aligned suspended-match projections and recovery validation around RESUME_PENDING. Players keep their resume proposal while spectators see status without save or resume controls.

September 24, 2026 · PR #23

Restore the roster workshop layout

Restored the account team builder’s roster workshop with recruit cards, roster value, resources, team controls, and an editable roster while the server catalog remains authoritative.

Document Candidate 03 deployment status

Recorded the DEV and PROD rollout of the marker-7 schema, Candidate 03 server package, verified backups, WebSocket handshakes, and environment-specific Hosting assets.

Add account-owned match-ready teams

Added server-catalog validation, named saved teams, owner checks, immutable match team snapshots, the marker-7 migration, and the builder-to-Play selection flow.

Moved Firebase Workload Identity Federation trust to the renamed repository and added reproducible Windows, Ubuntu, and release setup checks.
